    Over a finite extension of finite fields a stable module with scalar endomorphisms remains stable.

    Stability of all finite intermediate extensions implies stability over the algebraic extension. Adding a contractible regular summand makes the projective Hom spaces detect every proper nonzero submodule.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.isStable_extendObj_of_algebraic_of_end_dimension_one (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra k F] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)] [Finite k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k F] (P : TwoTerm R) {M : FGModuleCat R} (hs : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable M) (h1 : homFinrank k M M = 1) :
    (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P)).IsStable (extendObj k F R M)

    Over a finite field, scalar endomorphisms suffice for stability after every algebraic extension, in particular after extension to the algebraic closure.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.isStable_extendObj_algClosure_iff (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra k F] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)] [Finite k] [IsAlgClosed F] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k F] (P : TwoTerm R) {M : FGModuleCat R} (hs : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable M) :
    (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P)).IsStable (extendObj k F R M) ↔ homFinrank k M M = 1

    A stable module over a finite field is geometrically stable exactly when its endomorphism algebra has ground dimension one.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.algebraic_extension_of_split_stable_sum (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra k F] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)] [Finite k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k F] (P : TwoTerm R) {n : ℕ} {B : Fin n → FGModuleCat R} {X : FGModuleCat R} (e : X ≅ ⨁ B) (hb : ∀ (i : Fin n), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable (B i)) (hd : Function.Injective (CategoryTheory.toSkeleton ∘ B)) (h1 : ∀ (i : Fin n), homFinrank k (B i) (B i) = 1) :
    have C := fun (i : Fin n) => extendObj k F R (B i); Nonempty (extendObj k F R X ≅ ⨁ C) ∧ Function.Injective (CategoryTheory.toSkeleton ∘ C) ∧ ∀ (i : Fin n), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P)).IsStable (C i) ∧ homFinrank F (C i) (C i) = 1 ∧ Module.finrank F ↑(C i).obj = Module.finrank k ↑(B i).obj

    Over every algebraic extension, a direct sum of distinct stable modules with scalar endomorphisms retains its decomposition, stability and multiplicities.
